name: io.github.cyanheads/fcc-spectrum-mcp-server
title: fcc-spectrum-mcp-server
description: Search FCC radio licenses, find nearby transmitter sites, and see who is licensed on a frequency.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: FCC_SPECTRUM_MIRROR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local ULS index generations, current.json, the ingest lock, and temp zips. A relative path resolves against the working directory, so set an absolute path.

environmentVariables.name: FCC_SPECTRUM_SERVICES
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of weekly ULS service groups to index, case-insensitive. Opt-in: gmrs, ship, aircr.

environmentVariables.name: FCC_SPECTRUM_REDACT_INDIVIDUALS
environmentVariables.description: Redact individual licensees and trustee names and exclude individuals from name search. Only false/0/no/off disables it.

environmentVariables.name: FCC_SPECTRUM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: ULS bulk file host root, read at ingest time only.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
